newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 10.

text.p: These were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Army finds former police investigator hiding in jungles off Yala in southern Sri Lanka where Tamil Tiger separatists have been active recently.
A candiate contesting March 21 elections who was kidnapped in a Colombo suburb on Friday, released in Matale in central Sri Lanka, police say.
Government will try its utmost to ensure that the March 21 local government poll is free and fair, says President Kumaratunga.
Three out of four commissions investigating disappearances of youths have completed work after looking into 33,000 cases, says President Kumaratunga.

President Kumaratuna's estraged brother Anura Bandaranaike, now with main opposition United National Party, says the Sri Lanka Freedom Party of his sister and mother were also given weapons for protection during the 1989 insurgency.
